pull_requests.title: perf(parser): cache parsed templates
pull_requests.body: A mail merge renders one template for every recipient, and each render parsed that template again. parse now keeps the segments of the templates it has parsed and returns them on the next call for the same template, so a long-running calling program parses each template once. render and fields keep their behaviour.

pull_requests.title: feat(render): let a field name a default value
pull_requests.body: A field written {name|default} renders its default when the values passed to render hold no entry for name, so a mail merge can greet a recipient without a name as 'Dear friend'. A field without a default still raises MissingField when its value is missing, and fields lists each field as written.
